The '''Savareen sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It included the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] homeworld of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], located in the [[Tyrius system/Legends|Tyrius system]], as well as the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] in the [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]].
